AMENDED 2026-08-29 (ledger 2.141, Plan 17): `mainSessionTokens` is the new field and it is the one a stop-loss must be built from. Record it, or the next stop-loss multiplies a reviewer's rate by a task count again.

Method S6 gains a THIRD TERM (main-session ~200k x task count, one data point, revise at every close) and the lane-ruling consequence: at this rate a nine-task full-module build is TWO LIGHT phases, not one. NOT REVIEWED, so per method 9.4 this phase may not be called cheap and no actuals row is recorded in its CLOSE.
